entities.name: Masanao Goto
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Masanao Goto  was a Japanese leprologist. He was the son of first Shobun Gotō and was called the "second Shobun Gotō". He devoted his life to leprosy patients in Japan and on the island of Molokai in the Kingdom of Hawaii.
